title: Same profile, net debt at 4.1x EBITDA

input.facts: Hospital EHR platform with multi-year subscription contracts; recurring revenue is 72% of sales. Net debt is 4.1x EBITDA after a funded acquisition; management says it is comfortable with the level. The share price fell 28% on a delayed product release, now shipped. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: Net debt above 4x EBITDA is a kill criterion: Reject, whatever management says.
